capabilities: prompt ChatGPT from a canvas node via right-click
carry on a chat conversation across canvas nodes
configure ChatGPT session credentials (user agent, session token, clearance token)
extras: Uses unofficial ChatGPT web tokens (session, clearance) that may need refreshing every 2 hours; author states the code is mostly undocumented and messy, and streaming support and node edges are future work. Install also possible via BRAT or release files.
problem: Obsidian canvases have no built-in way to send prompts to ChatGPT from nodes or hold a conversation there.

relations.evidence: A plugin for Obsidian that allows you to create a canvas conversation using ChatGPT.

summary: Canvas plugin that lets you prompt ChatGPT from canvas nodes and build a conversation across them.
